provenance.justification: Pi-Bench (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14678) motivates hidden user intents, inter-task dependencies, and the distinction between task completion and proactivity in long-horizon personal-assistant trajectories. ASTRA-bench (https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01357) motivates grounding tool-use plans in time-evolving personal context; this fixture stays local and KOTA-owned instead of importing an external benchmark.
